title: Engineering Operations Review
description: Produce recurring evidence-backed engineering reviews with material changes, tracked actions, governed delivery, and historical outcomes.
setup_prompt: Use Engineering Operations Review with my governed intelligence data. Freeze the selected period, verify material changes and prior actions, draft audience-appropriate recommendations with evidence, require configured approval, and persist the report and delivery receipts.

setup_inputs.label: Review cadence, period, and comparison window
Audience, required sections, and sensitive-data rules
Action ownership and prior-review follow-up policy
Destinations, notification conditions, and approval policy

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Freeze period snapshots and persist reviews, decisions, actions, follow-ups, and receipts

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks schedules
recommended_tools.purpose: Run a proven review workflow at the approved cadence

recommended_tools.name: Notification MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Deliver an approved review to the configured audience

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Create explicitly approved follow-up work and persist its receipt

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Review completeness, metric comparability, and action tracking
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Review cadence, aggregation, ownership, notification, and history design
Handoffs from findings to governed action
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether reviews improve delivery, quality, and reliability decisions
Priority, operating cost, and stakeholder usefulness
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
